## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Integration tests run on SQLite and Postgres, if SQL changed
- [ ] User-facing documentation is in `docs/`, not `apps/docs/content`
- [ ] A `CHANGELOG.md` entry, if users will notice

Call out any change to:

- [ ] `tests/contract/access-manifest.json` (a security change)
- [ ] `tests/contract/public-api.json` (a public API change, see `docs/contributing/deprecation.md`)
